intro: Thor is the gryphon flight master stationed at the gryphon roost at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. As the vital aerial link between the beleaguered People's Militia and the capital city of Stormwind, he oversees the dispatch of couriers, scouts, and urgent messages across kingdom skies.

p: Stationed at Sentinel Hill's gryphon roost, Thor manages the flight roost that ties Westfall's frontier defenders to the heart of the kingdom. While the People's Militia struggles on the ground against roaming bandits, gnolls, and malfunctioning harvest golems, Thor ensures that crucial military dispatches and travelers can bypass the perilous roads altogether. Through his tamed gryphons, urgent requests for aid and reports from Gryan Stoutmantle reach the court in Stormwind far quicker than any ground messenger could manage.
